card.line: Bethsaida was a fishing town by the Sea of Galilee. It was home to some of Jesus' disciples, and He did miracles there.

moments.title: Jesus Withdraws to Bethsaida
moments.text: After the apostles returned and reported what they had done, Jesus took them away privately to a town called Bethsaida. The crowds followed, and He welcomed them, taught them, and healed those who needed it.

moments.title: Disciples Sent Ahead
moments.text: After the five thousand ate, Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go on ahead to Bethsaida. He dismissed the crowd and went up on the mountain to pray.

moments.title: A Blind Man Healed
moments.text: At Bethsaida, people begged Jesus to touch a blind man. He led the man out of the village and touched his eyes twice, and the man could see everything clearly.

moments.title: Home of Philip, Andrew, and Peter
moments.text: Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter. Jesus told Philip, "Follow Me," and Philip went to find Nathanael.

moments.title: Woe to Bethsaida
moments.text: Jesus spoke sharp words to Bethsaida because it saw His miracles and did not repent. He said Tyre and Sidon would have repented if they had seen them.
